name: Teen Volunteer (ages 15 and up)
what_you_do: Talk with visitors and help staff run activities. Keep the museum clean and ready. Help with camps and special events.
who_can_apply: Teens 15 and older. A guardian enters their name to consent for a minor.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Can count for school service hours.
duration: You choose hours on the application (daily, weekly, monthly or one time).
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Tell them your due date if you need service hours.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the volunteer page. You give contact info, free times, hours wanted, consent from a guardian and photo permission. Call (520) 792-9985 with questions.
notes: The museum hours listed on the page disagree, so confirm shift times.
